content:
The next content update will be published on September 2nd, 2025, with season 22 starting and there are numerous perk card changes. Here you can find an overview.

Changed perk cards

A hail of bullets

+3/6/9% damage per 30 units of ammunition spent. Max. 10 stacks.

Before: Big and Heavy

Big and Heavy (Patch 61)

Bullet hail (from patch 62)

Wrapped tightly

Weapons spin up 60% faster.

Before: Big and Heavy Professional

Big and Heavy Professional (Patch 61)

Tightly Wrapped (from Patch 62)

The big things

Your Bulletstorm stacking limit is doubled.

Before: Big and Heavy Masters

Heavy Gunner Master (Patch 61)

The big things (from patch 62)

Strong as a bear

Each stack of Bullets increases your strike attack damage by 5%.

Strong as a Bear (Patch 61)

Strong as a bear (from patch 62)

Load through

You keep half of your bullet stack when reloading. +1% reload speed per stack.

Charge Through (Patch 61)

Load through (from patch 62)

Iron Fist

Your fists deal more damage based on your damage resistance.
